'''Hashala''' is a [[novice]] in the [[White Tower]].

==Appearance==
Hashala has short, black hair that is styled in a {{Wiki|bob cut|bob}}.

==Activities==
When [[Siuan Sanche]], [[Gareth Bryne]], and [[Gawyn Trakand]] infiltrate the White Tower, Siuan finds Hashala on the ground floors of the Tower. Hashala then eagerly takes the three to [[Egwene al'Vere]].{{ref/book|12|41}}
